source.name: The Gate
source.capture_method: Anonymous read-only records requested through the same public data interface used by The Gate client.
source.copyright_boundary: This artifact stores aggregate counts, compact deck summaries, and a factual public-deck search index of card names and quantities. It does not copy article text, card text, card images, or builder notes.

signal_definitions.newest_public_records: Public or author-published gallery records ordered by their created_at timestamp. A record may have been made public later.
signal_definitions.homepage_recent: The four public records The Gate homepage would select by most recent updated_at timestamp at capture time. This is visibility/recency, not engagement rank.
signal_definitions.recent_public_frequency: Counts among records with exactly 50 main cards plus one Leader and one Gate within an exact trailing created_at window. This is a self-selected public-submission signal, not a player-population estimate or a ruling that the list is otherwise legal.
signal_definitions.common_card_inclusion: Number of records in a window containing a gameplay card at least once, with print-treatment suffixes collapsed. It is not copy count, recommendation, or win rate.
signal_definitions.tournament_result: A dated placement attached to a published The Gate tournament record. It is competitive evidence for that event only.
signal_definitions.popular_language_policy: Anko may call a leader, gate, or card frequent in recent public submissions. He must not call it the global meta, most played, best, or proven from this signal alone.
signal_definitions.deck_search_entry: A public deck name plus its recorded Leader, Gate, and main-card names and quantities. This supports exact deck-name and archetype search; it is not strategic analysis or a recommendation.

engagement_availability.note: The public deck pages do not display aggregate view, save, or share counts, and anonymous reads did not provide a usable engagement aggregate at capture time. No engagement ranking is claimed.

all_time_public_gallery_context.note: All-time gallery counts use records with exactly 50 main cards plus one Leader and one Gate. They do not establish current activity, unique players, or legality beyond that shape.

7d.frequency_basis: Records with exactly 50 main cards plus one Leader and one Gate.

14d.frequency_basis: Records with exactly 50 main cards plus one Leader and one Gate.

30d.frequency_basis: Records with exactly 50 main cards plus one Leader and one Gate.

not_claiming: This is not an official Azuki TCG source or deck ranking.
Public gallery frequency is not view, save, share, ownership, sales, attendance, or unique-player popularity.
A newly created or recently updated record is not necessarily a new archetype.
A deck name is user-authored and does not establish a canonical archetype label.
Tournament placements establish only the reported result at the named dated event, not a current global metagame or expected win rate.
The snapshot is time-bound and should be refreshed before making current claims after its capture date.
